title: Chapter 20 Arrival Of Hanji Palace
content:
Chapter 20 Arrival Of Hanji Palace

Somewhere upstream of the long river of time and space, the phantom, which had been running for unknown distance, finally stopped, and was still breathing heavily.

"Tianming, there will be a big boss from the Tianming Realm. I'm scared to death."

The phantom is still a little shocked at this moment.

He will never forget that aura in his life, and the same is true for him. He will never want to feel it again in his life.

In his opinion, there is nothing that can be done except looking up.

And if you are targeted by such a strong man or disgusted, then you are embarrassed. Apart from praying that he has a little bit of kindness and can leave him with a next life, you will be unable to do anything.

Finally, he turned around and took a careful look, and the phantom finally breathed a sigh of relief.

Immediately, he knelt down again.

"Thank you, the destiny boss, for not killing me!"

In the eyes of others, he is the invincible guardian of the long river of time and space. All the strong men who need to rely on the long river of time and space need to see his eyes, but in front of such a terrifying strong man, let alone himself.

Even the long river of time and space is just a toy for the other party.

In the room of Lu Xue in Huangcheng.

"Xiaoxue, it's okay with dad."

Looking at Lu Xue who was holding her tightly, Lu Daosheng said with joy.

Hearing this, Lu Xue slowly raised her head, her eyes still red.

"Dad, can you stop leaving me in the future?"

She was afraid that one day her father would not want her.

She has never had a mother since she was a child and is extremely dependent on her father.

Feeling Lu Xue's emotions, Lu Daosheng knew that his daughter did not blame him at all.

"Dad promises you that you will never leave you."

Hearing this, Lu Xue finally smiled.

"Lu Gou."

"good."

In this way, under the witness of the third party Gu Chen, Lu Daosheng and Lu Xue and his daughter swear.

Gu Chen: 6

"By the way, Xiaoxue, Dad has prepared a gift for you."

"Huh? What?"

Immediately, Lu Daosheng took out an exquisite necklace, which exuded a rich law of ice.

This was prepared for Lu Xue when she was preparing for her awakening constitution. Later, she found that Lu Xue could not adapt at that time, so she did not give it.

And now, Lu Xue has reached the quasi-emperor realm, and this necklace is very suitable.

"Wow, so beautiful, thank you dad."

Lu Xue took the necklace and put it on with joy on her face.

"Dad, is it good-looking?"

"My daughter looks good whenever she brings her."

Lu Daosheng said with a smile.

Then Lu Xue looked at Gu Chen at the door again, "Master, is it good-looking?"

"nice."

Gu Chen smiled slightly and nodded.

During the past three hundred years, Lu Daosheng was absent, so he acted as elder Lu Xue.

Now he also likes this well-behaved and cute apprentice very much.

I don’t even dare to scold me on weekdays.

In this way, Lu Xue's matter was solved perfectly.

Lu Daosheng suddenly felt very happy.

After a while, Lu Daosheng walked out of Lu Xue's room with satisfaction.

The next moment, Lu Daosheng soared into the sky and waved his hand.

Suddenly, everyone in the deserted city, including those outside the deserted city, felt an inexplicable force.

Immediately afterwards, a faint golden aura appeared quietly from the bodies of everyone, and then gradually became thicker.

Everyone was puzzled, what was going on?

However, some of the top strong men who knew the eyes were shocked.

"This is a technique of great fortune, which uses supreme power to improve one's fortune. It's an opportunity!"

Among the crowd, an inconspicuous old man looked at the phantom in the distance in the void and said respectfully.

When everyone around heard this, they were shocked.

"Who is that person? Is it our great benefactor?"

Everyone was surprised and happy, and began to guess the identity of the great benefactor.

At this time, a young man looked at the old man and asked.

"Senior, do you know who that great benefactor is?"

Since this strange old man can tell this magic, he must know the identity of the caster.

Then everyone also looked at the old man.

At this moment, the old man looked solemn and said slowly: "If you improve one person's luck, as long as your strength exceeds the heavenly way in this world, you can do it, but if you improve the luck of so many people, such methods are beyond the ancient times. I boldly guess. , It is very likely that this is done by the master of this supreme city, the lord of the wasteland city. "

After hearing the old man's analysis, everyone was surprised.

The master of this supreme city.

At this moment, everyone woke up one after another.

Yes, they were patronizing how awesome this giant city is, so wouldn’t the owner of this giant city be even more awesome?

"Thank you, Lord of Huangcheng!"

Suddenly, a man shouted to the sky.

The next moment, the golden luck on his body began to grow.

Seeing this, everyone around them stared out their eyes.

That's OK? !

"The Lord of the Huangcheng City is awesome!"

Buzz —

Luck grows.

"The Lord of the Wilderness City is the most handsome!"

Buzz —

Luck grows.

"Zhang San, an inner disciple of Huaqing Sect, thanked the Lord of Huangcheng for his real name. The Lord of the City is awesome!"

boom!

Suddenly, the young man named Zhang San's luck rose sharply, and his luck was like a dragon.

Everyone: Wang Defa!

On the side, the old man looked at all this calmly, without any action, but turned his head to look at the restless city center in the distance, and his expression became solemn.

"It seems that I have come to this place right."

The old man muttered to himself, then took a step towards the center of the city and disappeared on the spot.

In the void, Lu Daosheng, who had done all this, felt the praise of the crowd and smiled slightly.

People are still too enthusiastic.

At this moment, an extremely cold breath suddenly surged from the periphery of the deserted city.

Nowadays, the deserted city is divided into three parts by Lu Daosheng, namely the outer city where outsiders can step into, the inner city where the natives of the deserted city and some special people are located, and finally the city lord's mansion where Lu Daosheng and his confidants are located.

The level is also very strict. No one can cross the line without Lu Daosheng's permission.

Outer city.

Everyone felt the chill and trembled.

What kind of existence is this?

I saw a woman with a beautiful face and a cold breath coming slowly from a distance.

Beside her, there were several powerful men with terrifying breath.

Seeing the clothes of these people, some people were shocked.

"Hanji Palace!"

"What? Are you saying they are from Tianshan Hanji Palace?"

"Otherwise, which Hanji Palace is there?"

Hiss~

All of a sudden, everyone took a breath of cold air.

This force is not only strong, but also very mysterious. It stays on Tianshan all year round and doesn't care what happens in the outside world, unless the Tianxuan world is about to be destroyed.

It can be said to be a transcendent force.

And now, these people have actually come to the deserted city.

At this time, the woman looked at the surrounding environment, and her expression was also extremely shocked.

She couldn't imagine that this deserted city would be so heaven-defying.

Looking at the hazy towering trees and towers in the distance, Ye Hanshuang's breathing suddenly became rapid.

"Palace Master, here?"

A strong man from Hanji Palace said sluggishly.

Not only Ye Hanshuang, they, including all the people who had just entered the deserted city, were like this, without exception.

Hearing this, Ye Hanshuang came back to her senses and said solemnly: "This place is extremely complicated. We should not cause trouble and don't forget our purpose."

This time she came to find the monster with the blood of the Ice Phoenix. Such a genius can only be someone from their Hanji Palace.

A month ago, she came here, but the deserted city had not yet been opened. She searched outside in vain and had to wait for the city gate to open.

Now, as soon as the city opened, she came in to look for it.

At this time, a piece of information suddenly flooded into her mind.

It was the rules of the deserted city.

Seeing this rule, Ye Hanshuang's face was solemn.

The Lord of the Deserted City, how about going to pay a visit first?

It's just right to ask where the monster with the blood of the Ice Phoenix is.

She believed that he must be in the deserted city.

Just as she was thinking, someone suddenly asked in confusion: "This deserted city seems a bit deserted."

"How can it be deserted? Aren't there so many people here?"

"No, except for us outsiders, there are no locals in this deserted city?"
